_meta.title: Mongolian word list — Praise to the Twenty-One Tārās (general grade)
_meta.choices: Cyrillic (Khalkha) · clear modern Mongolian that keeps the liturgical Buddhist words practitioners know (Дарь эх, мөргөмүй, бурхан), with old grammar forms (лугаа) modernised · mantra syllables as chanted in Mongolia, in Cyrillic (Ум дарэ дүдарэ дүрэ суха) · flagged picks decided by Claude, with the reason written down (Tenkal, 2026-09-25).
_meta.decided_by: Claude pick — user delegated flagged picks ("same as Nepali"), 2026-09-25
_meta.sources_note: (1) the established Mongolian Buddhist vocabulary, translated from Tibetan since the 17th-century Kanjur (source code `standard`); (2) the recited Mongolian forms of the mantra syllables, as pinned in the track glossary Gemini/mn/glossary.tsv (`recitation`); (3) the Gemini zero-shot mn draft (Gemini/mn/, 2026-09-17), which already writes in this liturgical style (`mt`). No reference text: the Mongolian Kanjur version could not be fetched here. Several spirit-class words are uncertain and flagged for a native reviewer.

source_labels.recitation: the syllable as chanted in Mongolia

_meta.baseline: the Gemini zero-shot draft (Gemini/mn/, 2026-09-17) already uses 117 of 136 locked words (86%). Misses: нүүр for ཞལ (the draft wrote тэргүүн 'head'), лянхуа (усан төрмөл), дүддара for дүдарэ, the Sanskrit title, 1-18 moon named only by its kenning, the new words for spirits and yakṣas.

homage.note: Flagged. The stem, so the refrain мөргөмүй and the noun мөргөл (I-0, 1-22) both match; hint мөргөмүй. The refrain is the liturgical form every Mongolian reciter knows, kept on purpose in the modern register.

tara.note: the established Mongolian name (also the track glossary).

benefits.note: the standard phrase; the draft has it at I-2 and 2-0.

noble_venerable.note: རྗེ་བཙུན = богд, འཕགས་མ = хутагт, as the draft has it at I-3.

sanskrit_title.mn: Намо Тара Экавимшати Стотра Гунахита Сака
sanskrit_title.note: Flagged. The Sanskrit title in Cyrillic, as Mongolian texts write Sanskrit titles; the draft broke it into lower-case pieces (нама тара … гуна хита сака).

praise.note: the stem (магтаал, магтсан, магтагдсан — the vowel drops); hint магтаал.

blessed_tara.note: Flagged. བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ is Mongolian Ялгуусан төгс нөгчсөн; the core Төгс нөгчсөн is common to every form. The draft's Итгэлт ('protector', མགོན་པོ) is a different word.

perfect_buddha.note: Samyaksambuddha = Үнэн төгс туулсан бурхан; the core is locked so inflected forms match.

blessed_one.note: Flagged, with blessed_tara (the draft had Итгэлт).

face.note: Flagged. The draft wrote тэргүүн ('head') at 1-2 and 1-8, which is wrong for ཞལ.

lotus.note: Flagged. The ordinary Mongolian word; the draft's усан төрмөл ('water-born') is a calque of ཆུ་སྐྱེས a general reader may not recognise. 1-3 keeps both ideas (усанд төрсөн лянхуа).

lotus_face.note: 1-8 only, her own lotus face (1-1 is the lotus from the Lord's face).

light.note: гэрэл; locked as the stem гэр because the vowel drops when it inflects (гэрлийн, гэрлийг). Hint гэрэл.

blaze.note: a short stem, because the verb changes its vowel (бадрах, бадарсан, бадрангуй); hint бадрах.

moon.note: the ordinary word. At 1-18 the draft wrote only the kenning гөрөөсний тэмдэгт ('deer-marked one'); the moon must be named.

peace.note: the stem (амарлингуй, амар амгалан); hint амар амгалан.

feet.note: the honorific word for a deity's feet; consistent in the draft.

tuttare.note: as chanted (Ум дарэ дүдарэ дүрэ суха); the track glossary pins it; the draft wavered (дүддара).

spirit.note: Flagged, uncertain. The draft's Гарва at 1-6 is not a Mongolian word for འབྱུང་པོ. чөтгөр ('spirit, ghost') is the widely known word, kept apart from ад (གདོན). A native reviewer should confirm.

destroy.note: the stem (дарагч, даран); consistent in the draft.

supreme.note: Flagged. 'highest', kept apart from их; the draft had маш ('very') at 1-10.

joy.note: the stem (баясгалан, баясах); consistent in the draft.

syllable_hum.note: hum + syllable, as the draft has it.

perfectly_endowed.note: perfectly + endowed; the draft's сайтар төгссөн.

goddess.note: Flagged. The standard word for ལྷ་མོ and the draft's; but Охин тэнгэр is also the name of Palden Lhamo in Mongolia. The commentaries say the goddess is Tārā herself — a native reviewer should decide whether to write Дарь эх here.

vetala.note: Flagged. རོ་ལངས 'risen corpse'; the draft had босоолон / босоарь. Locked as the stem; hint босоо үхдэл.

demon.note: the standard word for གདོན; the draft has it.

yaksha.note: Flagged. The Mongolian calque of གནོད་སྦྱིན ('harm-doer'), the draft's word at 1-21 (1-6 had хорлолт бирд).

might.note: the draft's word (амарлингуйн хүч); kept apart from эрх.

om.note: Mongolian-only entry: the syllable as chanted (track glossary).

svaha.note: Mongolian-only entry: the syllable as chanted (track glossary).

hara.note: Mongolian-only entry: the syllable as chanted (track glossary).

tara_syllable.note: Mongolian-only entry: the syllable as chanted (track glossary).

tara_sanskrit.note: Mongolian-only split: in the Sanskrit title line (I-1) ཏཱ་རཱ stays the Sanskrit Тара; everywhere else she is Дарь эх.
